clues: This town is in Chapare, a part of Bolivia, just east of Cochabamba. It is the seat of its own town lands, by that big city.
Winter days here can climb far higher than summer days, a strange flip. Rain is rare in winter, yet summer brings heavy rain.
In 2002, fierce riots broke out here over the closing of a coca market. The fights left dead on both sides before they ended.
The coca leader at the heart of those riots was Evo Morales. He went on to rule the whole land as its president from 2006 to 2019.
Fine old buildings from post-colonial days still stand in its inner streets. Some have been lost for lack of care by the town hall.
